description: This script initializes and manages external diff and merge tools for Git, particularly designed for use with 'git difftool' and 'git mergetool'. It handles launching diff/merge tools, prompts the user for confirmation, and manages the execution flow based on Git configurations and environmental variables.

methods.name: should_prompt
methods.description: Determines if the diff tool should prompt the user before launching by checking Git configuration values.

methods.name: use_ext_cmd
methods.description: Checks if an external command is explicitly specified for the diff/merge operation.

methods.name: launch_merge_tool
methods.description: Prepares and launches the merge tool with the provided file paths, handling prompts and external commands.
